name: Old Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion
scope: The Old Cathedral at Aksum after the eighteenth-century reconstruction, modeled in 1893 with its lintelled west portico, flat crenellated roof and stepped Aksumite podium.
era: 1893 recorded exterior, before the roof and portico alterations of 1908.

stories.title: Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion

originalReview.notes: The Smithsonian’s 1896 original book leaf shows the cathedral in the pre-1908 phase. The west portico has three openings under a horizontal lintel, rounded battlements, a small central roof feature and broad stone steps.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Checked the published Qualla article and related media entries first. Their building photographs use FAL or attribution licenses. Used the original Smithsonian scan of the 1896 edition for the recorded 1893 exterior.
